name: Kepler Docs
postCreateCommand: pip install -q -e . && pip install -q pre-commit && pre-commit install && gomplate -d adopters=./data/adopters.yaml -f templates/adopters.md -o docs/project/adopters.md && echo && echo '✅ Dev environment ready' && echo "   Python:   $(python --version 2>&1 | cut -d' ' -f2)" && echo "   gomplate: $(gomplate --version 2>&1 | cut -d' ' -f3)" && echo "   mkdocs:   $(mkdocs --version 2>&1 | cut -d' ' -f3)" && echo
